en: Sepia-toned panoramic aerial view of a city in a valley surrounded by mountains. A river with a metal bridge crosses the foreground, leading into a densely built historic center with church towers and urban blocks. At the top left is printed the caption "Trento - Veduta generale". The left edge shows holes, suggesting it was once bound in an album or booklet.
